content: The point of intersection $$\mathrm{C}$$ of the plane $$8 x+y+2 z=0$$ and the line joining the points $$\mathrm{A}(-3,-6,1)$$ and $$\mathrm{B}(2,4,-3)$$ divides the line segment $$\mathrm{AB}$$ internally in the ratio $$\mathrm{k}: 1$$. If $$\mathrm{a}, \mathrm{b}, \mathrm{c}(|\mathrm{a}|,|\mathrm{b}|,|\mathrm{c}|$$ are coprime) are the direction ratios of the perpendicular from the point $$\mathrm{C}$$ on the line $$\frac{1-x}{1}=\frac{y+4}{2}=\frac{z+2}{3}$$, then $$|\mathrm{a}+\mathrm{b}+\mathrm{c}|$$ is equal to ___________.
